entities.name: MS identity
entities.description: Information element that may be included to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE during a combined attach procedure.

entities.name: Combined attach
entities.description: Procedure during which the MS identity IE may be included to assign or unassign a new TMSI to the UE.

entities.name: TMSI
entities.description: Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity that can be assigned or unassigned to a UE via the MS identity IE during combined attach.

relations.description: The combined attach procedure may include the MS identity IE for TMSI assignment/unassignment.
The MS identity IE is used to assign or unassign a TMSI to the UE.
